# The Vertical AI

> The Vertical AI builds an AI-native enterprise operating system for voice, chat and workflow agents in regulated industries. It runs on VeloxCore, a low-latency inference engine (sub-500ms responses) that can be deployed in private cloud, on-premise or air-gapped environments. Its agents handle collections, sales, support and compliance conversations in 36+ languages, with RBI, DPDP, GDPR and HIPAA-aligned governance.

Key facts:

- Company: The Vertical AI (website: thevertical.ai)
- Headquarters: 513B, 5th Floor, Phase II, 769 Spencer Plaza, Anna Salai, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600002, India
- Contact: info@thevertical.ai, +91 70921 16868
- Customers named on the website: Kotak Mahindra Bank, Bajaj Finserv, TVS Credit, DRA Homes, SMK MG
- Main use cases: loan collections and EMI reminders, lead response and qualification, customer support, call auditing, AI compliance
- Industries served: banking and BFSI, microfinance, automotive, BPO, telecom, EdTech, healthcare, ecommerce, travel and hospitality, HR and recruitment
- Leadership background: founders from IIM Calcutta and Kellogg with 18+ years of scaling businesses

## Platform

- [Mozhi OS: AI Voice Agents](https://thevertical.ai/platform/mozhi): Human-like AI voice agents for inbound and outbound collections, sales and support calls. Sub-500ms latency, 36+ languages, RBI and GDPR compliant.
- [Conversa OS: AI Chat Agents](https://thevertical.ai/platform/conversa): AI chat agents on WhatsApp, web and in-app that run workflows, not just replies. 36+ languages including Indian regional languages, with human handover and audit trails.
- [CLEO: AI Lead Response and CRM Automation](https://thevertical.ai/platform/cleo): Replies to every inbound lead in seconds, qualifies it, books the meeting and updates the CRM automatically. Built for real estate and BFSI sales teams.
- [Maestro: AI Agent Orchestration](https://thevertical.ai/platform/maestro): Orchestrates AI agents, human teams and legacy systems with policy-driven control. 100+ integrations, 1M+ events per day, full auditability.
- [Insights OS: Conversation Intelligence](https://thevertical.ai/platform/insights): Audits 100% of calls, not a sample. Scores every conversation for quality, intent, sentiment and compliance with real-time dashboards.
- [Guardian OS: AI Compliance and Audit](https://thevertical.ai/platform/guardian): Enforces compliance before an AI agent acts. Real-time PII scrubbing, policy enforcement and continuous auditing aligned to RBI, DPDP, SOC 2 and HIPAA.

## Industries

- [AI for Banking and BFSI](https://thevertical.ai/industry/bfsi): AI voice and chat agents for banks and NBFCs: compliant collections, EMI reminders, KYC and sales in 36+ languages.
- [AI for Microfinance](https://thevertical.ai/industry/microfinance): Vernacular AI voice agents for microfinance institutions and NBFC-MFIs: EMI reminders, repayment follow-ups and re-loan campaigns. RBI and MFIN-aligned, on-premise ready.
- [AI for Automotive Dealerships](https://thevertical.ai/industry/automotive): Answers every dealership call, qualifies leads and books test drives and service slots 24/7. Multilingual and CRM-integrated.
- [AI for BPOs and Contact Centres](https://thevertical.ai/industry/bpo): Voice and chat agents that absorb tier-1 call volume, automate QA on 100% of calls and support multi-client compliance.
- [AI for Telecom and ISPs](https://thevertical.ai/industry/telecom): Agents for billing queries, recharge and bill reminders, plan changes, KYC re-verification, outage updates and churn-save calls.
- [AI for EdTech Admissions](https://thevertical.ai/industry/edtech): Calls every student enquiry in seconds, qualifies intent, books counselling sessions and demo classes, and runs fee reminders.
- [AI for Healthcare](https://thevertical.ai/industry/healthcare): Voice agents for hospitals, clinics and diagnostic chains: appointment scheduling, reminders and patient queries with HIPAA-aligned auditing and on-premise deployment.
- [AI for Ecommerce and D2C](https://thevertical.ai/industry/ecommerce): Automates order-status queries, returns, COD confirmation, address verification, NDR recovery and cart recovery across voice and chat.
- [AI for Travel and Hospitality](https://thevertical.ai/industry/travel): Agents for bookings, changes, cancellations and guest service, connected to reservation systems, in 36+ languages.
- [AI for HR and Recruitment](https://thevertical.ai/industry/hr-services): Voice and chat agents for high-volume hiring: applicant screening calls, interview scheduling and joining follow-ups. ATS-integrated and multilingual.
